players.product: Sqale neutral-atom quantum computer (plus quantum clocks and RF sensors)

quarterly_data.signal: Infleqtion (10-Q): in July 2026 announced a signed contract to deploy a fault-tolerant neutral-atom quantum computer at the Illinois Quantum & Microelectronics Park, delivery planned in 2027, initially targeting 50 logical qubits with a roadmap to 100 logical qubits via modular upgrades; the system is based on its Sqale platform, already delivering workloads at customer sites, and supports hybrid classical-quantum workloads through NVIDIA's NVQLink integration.
quarterly_data.figure: 50 logical qubits initial target (roadmap to 100); delivery planned 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Partner NVIDIA: in October 2025 Infleqtion announced a partnership with NVIDIA to deploy an NVQLink-enabled quantum supercomputing system at the Illinois Quantum & Microelectronics Park, integrating its Sqale quantum computers with NVIDIA's GPU-accelerated systems via NVQLink.
